Pasal 1 angka 12 defines “Korban” as women who experience violence threats and/or “menjadi objek perdagangan/eksploitasi” (trafficking/exploitation). Protection obligations then apply to “korban” generally, and Pasal 11(2) lists service types for “korban kekerasan” and other vulnerable groups; Pasal 16 provides information/access to protection and free legal aid for various vulnerable women. While the service lists often say “korban kekerasan” rather than repeating “korban perdagangan”, the definition makes trafficking/exploitation victims part of the victim category covered by the protection framework.
